transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I can’t seem to keep my work in order anymore. At the laundry, the tickets, receipts, notes, customer jobs—everything ends up piled together, and then I don’t know what to handle first. It’s getting hard to keep up.
Have you had this kind of trouble staying organized since you were a child?

Yes, I think so. Even back in grade school, teachers would tell my mother I was bright, but kind of scattered. I’d talk out of turn, lose my papers, and need reminders to finish my work. It’s been around a long time.
Do you get easily distracted while you’re trying to work?

Yes, very easily. I’ll start checking the day’s dry-cleaning orders, and at first I’m focused, but after a few minutes my mind has wandered off—to labels, choir plans, something at home. Then I look back and realize I missed half of what I was supposed to be checking.
Do you often act or speak before thinking, like interrupting people or blurting things out?

Yes, I do. I’ll jump in with an answer before someone’s even finished asking me—my daughter, a customer, even the trainer at work. Then sometimes I realize I answered the wrong question because I didn’t let them finish. It’s embarrassing.
Do these problems with attention and organization also cause trouble for you at home, not just at work?

Yes, it does. At home it shows up too, but even outside work—like at church—I’ve had to step back from helping lead some planning because people were getting frustrated with me. And at the shop it’s caused real problems, like late orders, mix-ups with billing, and some tense moments with staff and customers. It’s not just me feeling scattered; it affects other people too.
Have your attention and organization problems gotten noticeably worse recently compared with how they usually were for you?

Yes. I’d say it’s been noticeably worse for about two years now—maybe two years and a couple months. It really started causing trouble when I began changing the business into that more complicated boutique kind of model. Since then, keeping things organized has been a lot harder for me.
Around the time these problems got noticeably worse, were you diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness?
No, not that I know of. I wasn’t diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness around then.
During the past two years, have you been feeling excessively worried or tense most days?
I don’t think so, no. I mean, I get stressed when things pile up, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been excessively worried or tense most days.
During the past two years, have you often felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
No, not really. I’ve had frustrating days, sure, but I wouldn’t say I’ve often felt down or hopeless over the past couple years.
